question: At which loci must the moon be meditated on to be held as gone to the heart?
premises: The moon is the object of meditation.
Meditation is enjoined at the navel and at the head.
The moon is also to be held as gone to the heart.
inference: One should meditate on the moon at the navel and head, and also as present in the heart.
uncertainties: The relation between the three loci is not made explicit here.
plain_english: One should meditate on the moon, O goddess, at the navel and the head, and as gone to the heart.
